## Objective and atomic outcome

Certify, using genuine out-of-sample known-truth evidence, whether the leading geo-aware
structured-time Ridge mean structure generalizes sufficiently to become a later implementation
candidate:

```text
log(Y_gt) = alpha_g + B_t + controls_gt*gamma + sum_c beta_c f_c(X_gtc) + epsilon_gt
```

This is certification only. Do not implement production geo/time effects, retransformation,
partial pooling, replay, optimizer/economics, decision invariance, national-channel policy,
MIP/GeoX behavior, or release thresholds.

## Bounded candidate matrix and holdout design

Pre-register this bounded matrix before empirical execution; do not expand it into an exhaustive
Cartesian product:

| Candidate | Role |
|---|---|
| A. Global intercept + pooled media + controls | Current production reference |
| B. Geo effects + pooled media + controls | Known-geo baseline comparator |
| C. Geo effects + existing bounded Fourier/trend + pooled media + controls | Leading structured candidate from prior certification |
| D. One alternate existing structured-time basis, only if needed | Basis-robustness screen; no exhaustive search |

Saturated week effects are historical/reference evidence only and are not a competitive production
candidate. Do not introduce partial pooling, retransformation, new estimators, or new DGP frameworks.
Use existing H6 worlds and deterministic seeds across multiple worlds. Required holdouts are:

1. future-time holdout: train on earlier weeks and evaluate later unseen weeks;
2. geo holdout: evaluate unseen geos only where semantics are valid; fixed geo effects cannot
   predict an unseen geo without a justified fallback, so report unseen-time/known-geo and
   unseen-geo generalization separately;
3. short-history stress: mask/censor selected geo training histories using existing synthetic
   panels with preregistered long/medium/short lengths;
4. independent-world generalization across multiple H6 worlds.

Holdout construction must preserve geo/week ordering, carry only pre-holdout recursive adstock
state, fit no nuisance parameters on holdout outcomes, and avoid future information in trend/time
features or tuning. Random row-level splitting is prohibited.

## Required metrics and preregistered interpretation bands

Before runs, record exact worlds/seeds, split boundaries, short-history masks, candidate matrix,
primary metrics, and failure conditions in the report. Measure held-out log error, current plain-exp
level error, pooled beta/sign/contribution/lift recovery, held-out full-panel Delta-mu recovery,
known-geo baseline recovery, structured-time baseline recovery, residual geo/time pattern, lag-1
serial correlation, descriptive heteroskedasticity, and national variation/rank/conditioning.

Research interpretation bands (not release thresholds):

| Metric | High / intermediate / material |
|---|---|
| Holdout log-error degradation vs global reference | `<=10%` / `>10–25%` / `>25%` |
| Pooled beta relative error | `<=10%` / `>10–25%` / `>25%` |
| Held-out Delta-mu absolute error | `<=0.02` / `>0.02–0.05` / `>0.05` modeling units |
| Geo/time nuisance recovery error | `<=10%` / `>10–25%` / `>25%` truth SD |
| Coefficient instability across splits/worlds | `<=10%` / `>10–25%` / `>25%` relative change |
| Short-history degradation vs long-history | `<=10%` / `>10–25%` / `>25%` |
| Heteroskedasticity and national warning | descriptive only; no post-hoc release bar |

Candidate selection must jointly consider holdout generalization, truth/media recovery, Delta-mu,
estimability, stability, residual contamination, short-history behavior, assumptions, and complexity;
RMSE alone cannot promote a candidate. No band authorizes production implementation or changes DR-04.

## Required conclusions and downstream boundaries

Classify each separately as `supported_for_implementation`, `requires_more_evidence`, `rejected`,
or `research_only`:

1. geo baseline for known-geography prediction;
2. geo baseline for unseen geos;
3. structured-time family;
4. short-history readiness;
5. national-channel compatibility;
6. residual readiness for retransformation certification;
7. full-panel Delta-mu recovery readiness.

Do not perform retransformation/smearing, partial-pooling, decision-invariance, replay, optimizer,
national-policy implementation, or production mean-structure work. Preserve the sequence
mean-structure calibration -> retransformation calibration -> independent decision invariance.
